reviews.text: Older building but very carrying staff. When they called to check up on our cat they showed concern and care. Not common at many vets these days

Thank goodness for Northridge Pet Hospital.
We’ve been coming here since we moved to the valley in 2021.
One of my Pomeranians was born with afew health issues and this has been the only veterinary clinic that he wags his tail to get in the car because he knows he is going to see Maya and his girlfriends (lol)
In our house we have to spell the word “Vet” because he gets soooo excited to go 😆

We feel so very loved everytime we go in there and in an economy of rising prices…I’ve noticed that this lovely team of women always take the time to break down the cost, keep prices reasonable and explain everything we need to know about medications and treatments.
They truly care about both my boys and all other pets!
Thankyou NPH…you have us for life! ♥️♥️

I used to highly recommend this place, but unfortunately something has changed.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for years and was always happy with the service. My most recent experience, however, was extremely disappointing.

I was about 15 minutes late to my appointment and was told by Maya she wanted to cancel it because of the delay. The problem is that when the appointment was scheduled with Maya, I was never told that being 15 minutes late could result in cancellation. What makes this even more frustrating is that almost every time I’ve come here, I’ve personally had to wait 30–45 minutes past my scheduled appointment time.

The bigger issue was the pricing.

When I scheduled the appointment two weeks in advance, I was told that because my dog is now 10 years old, a veterinarian examination was required. I was quoted $75 for the exam, plus approximately $60–$70 for the vaccines and anal gland expression. We discussed the pricing over the phone, so I arrived expecting that approximate total.

Instead, I was given a bill of approximately $230 for the exam, vaccines, and anal gland expression. In previous years, I had paid around $63 for the same routine services.

When I questioned the significant price difference, I was given explanations about increased costs and expenses. I completely understand that prices can increase, but the customer should be informed of the actual price before the appointment, especially when I specifically called two weeks in advance to ask about the cost.

What happened next was even more disappointing. I decided to move my dog to another veterinarian and asked for her medical records. Instead of simply helping me with the transfer, I was questioned and accused of potentially altering the records using AI. I was honestly shocked by that accusation.

After being a loyal customer for years, this experience completely changed my opinion of the practice.

I’m not upset that prices can increase. I’m upset about the lack of transparency, the inconsistent communication, and the way I was treated when I questioned the charges and requested my dog’s records.

I’m now looking for a new veterinarian where I can feel that transparency, honesty, and trust come before making a sale.
we brought our pet here recently and found the front staff to be rude, unhelpful and impatient

Dr. Williamson at Northridge Pet Hospital saved my very sick cat. I cannot be happier with the outcome. Max is FIV positive and I didn't think he would make it. He didn't eat or drink for a week and it seemed like his organs were already shutting down.

Do not bring your pets here. My sweet dog died under the care of vet Williams during a normally safe dental procedure, and the vet and manager refused to come out and speak with me after. My sister and I waited for 2 HOURS to speak to Williams and a manager and no one ever came out. This horrible bedside manner made a traumatic experience even more traumatic. They do not care about you or your animals here - they treated my dog like she was a rag doll and had nothing to say to me after. (And yes they did charge me for the procedure and then tried to get me to pay for the cremation. That was their main concern - making money after their negligence.)
Amazing care and customer service. Prices are beyond reasonable. I take both my senior dog and cat here. Couldn't recommend enough!

AVOID THIS CLINIC- I don’t usually leave reviews, I Witnessed the Most Heartless Behavior I’ve Ever Seen at a Vet

I was in the waiting room when a young woman lost her dog due to the cause of the vets negligence.

The way the staff handled the situation was absolutely disgusting. Not a single one of them showed empathy. They acted like she was a problem, not a grieving pet owner whose dog had just died under their care. No comfort, no apology, no explanation — just blank stares, awkward shuffling, and zero accountability.

She asked to speak to the vet who operated on her dog and was completely brushed off. The vet refused to come out and say a word. I watched her cry in that lobby while the staff looked the other way like it was an inconvenience.

This place is cold, careless, and completely devoid of compassion. If they can’t even show basic human decency in a moment like that, what makes you think they’ll treat your pet with care behind closed doors?

There is something deeply wrong with how this clinic is run. I didn’t even have an appointment — I walked out and took my pet elsewhere because I could not, in good conscience, let these people touch him after what I saw.

DO NOT bring your animal here. They don’t deserve your trust, your money, or access to anyone’s beloved pet.

My family and I have been going to NPH since we first moved into the neighborhood and not once have we regretted it. Maya, Allison, Dr. Williams, and everyone else there has taken amazing care of our fur babies. They always do their absolute best to help out everyone. I could not ask for a better vet and I am so grateful for them! <3

I never usually post reviews but I had to in this case because every time I call Northridge Pet Hospital (which happens to be our Vet) the main receptionist is extremely RUDE & CONDESCENDING

Every time I call I just brush it off like maybe she's just having a bad day but I'm convinced she hates her job and definitely hates people

I love the Doctor there because she is extremely sweet and patient and never rushes you off the phone but I'm never going back there because of the main receptionist (don't know her name but it looks like everyone has complained about her in the past because she's extremely rude, hostile, combative & condescending 100%)

This family-run clinic was recommended to me by a friend and fellow cat mom. Turns out my aunt used bring her animals here twenty years ago! My spicy senior cat who suffers from hyperthyroidism and kidney disease has received excellent care from Dr. Williams and the team. Prices are competitive for the area and there is no “upselling” of extraneous products or tests. The staff and team are longtime employees and I trust them wholeheartedly.

I trust this vet explicitly with my dog and my cats. They are SO caring and kind. They take their time to explain everything and give you a detailed breakdown of costs so that you can make the best choice for your pet that also fits into your budget. Every person that works there is an absolute gem!!
Best vet our cat has ever had. He's really old and they gave him a new lease on life
This facility is the greatest. The DR And staff are very caring and professional. Very reasonable in cost. Your pet will be induldidually cared for because your in good hands.
I would refer everyone to this hospital because the staff goes above and beyond to help your animal. I got the best service for my Great Pyrenees with her surgery follow ups.
They do great work and take care of your pets
The staff is the best! They are so sweet and they follow up. They took amazing care of our kitty Squish! Thank you!

Just rude and greedy. My puppy died of distemper because of them. After spending almost $300 for her initial vet visit to have them tell me she was HEALTHY!! And when I told them she was getting worse. Another $500. I asked for a higher …
